tbesh_html: price of a life, ransom, bribe

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.
